connect.title: Sync across devices
connect.intro: Keep your villages the same on your computer and your phone. Sync is optional and free. Pick where the copy lives.
connect.another: You can pick another provider before you sign in.
connect.firstSync: Choose what to keep on the first sync if both sides already have data. Nothing is replaced before you decide.

google.step1: Sign in with Google in this window.
google.step2: Allow access to the files that Gamerdex creates. The app cannot see your other files.

github.step1: Create an empty private repository named {repository}. Tick Add a README file.
github.step2: Sign in with GitHub, then give Gamerdex Sync access to that repository only.

dropbox.step1: Sign in with Dropbox in this window.
dropbox.step2: Allow access to the Gamerdex app folder. The app cannot see your other files.

microsoft.step1: Sign in with your personal Microsoft account in this window.
microsoft.step2: Allow access to the Gamerdex app folder. The app cannot see your other files.

points.item1: Your villages are saved as one file in your own storage, plus a small file for the list of devices.
points.item2: Gamerdex has no server that stores your data. Your browser talks to your storage directly.
points.item3: Building instances, troops, heroes, equipment, pets and achievements merge one by one, and the higher level wins. A reset carries over when the other device did not change that level.
points.item4: If both devices change the same name, queue, running upgrade, trophy count or reset time, you choose which one to keep.
points.item5: Each device keeps its own active village. Sync never changes it.
points.item6: Disconnect at any time. Your villages stay on every device.

repository.title: Set up your data repository
repository.body: Your data is kept in a private repository named {name} in your GitHub account. Gamerdex Sync can only reach that one repository.
repository.checkFailed: Your repositories could not be loaded. Check your connection and check again.
repository.public: The repository {fullName} is public. Make it private in its GitHub settings, then check again. A public repository cannot be used, because anyone could read your data.

steps.create: Create a private repository named {name}. Tick Add a README file.
steps.install: Give Gamerdex Sync access to that repository only. Choose Only select repositories, then pick {name}.
steps.recheck: Come back here and check again.

error.rateLimit: The provider is limiting requests. Sync will work again in a few minutes.
error.notFound: The repository was not found. Choose it again.
error.server: The provider did not answer correctly. Try again later.
error.data: The synced data is not valid, so nothing was changed.
error.busy: Another device keeps changing the data. Try again in a moment.
error.other: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
error.reauth: Your sign in ended. Sign in again to keep syncing.
error.forbidden: GitHub refused access to the repository. Check that Gamerdex Sync has Read and write access to Contents, then sync again.
error.notFoundFolder: A file or folder in {provider} was not found. Sync again.
error.forbiddenFolder: {provider} refused access. Sign in again and allow access to the files that Gamerdex creates.

choice.title: This device and the cloud both have data
choice.body: This is the first sync from this device. Pick what to do. Nothing is deleted from the cloud until you choose.
choice.mergeHint: Keep everything from both. The higher level wins.
choice.keepLocalHint: Replace the cloud data with the data on this device.
choice.keepCloudHint: Replace the data on this device with the cloud data.

conflicts.title: Changes that could not be merged
conflicts.body: Two devices changed the same value. The cloud value was kept. Pick this device's value to use it instead.
conflicts.deletedEdited: One device removed this and another changed it. The changed version was kept.

banner.title: {count, plural, one {{amount} change needs a decision} other {{amount} changes need a decision}}
banner.body: Two devices changed the same value. The cloud value is kept until you decide.
banner.waiting: The first sync is waiting for your choice.

villages.title: Villages
villages.note: Deleting a village removes it from the sync file on the next sync.

activity.title: Recent sync activity
activity.merged: Merged the changes of both sides.
activity.conflicts: {count, plural, one {{amount} change needs a decision.} other {{amount} changes need a decision.}}

settings.title: Sync settings
settings.autoHint: Syncs when the tracker opens and a few seconds after each change.
settings.focus: Check for changes when I return to the tab
settings.focusHint: Pulls newer cloud data when you switch back to the tracker.
settings.metered: Wait for me on a metered connection
settings.meteredHint: Skips automatic syncs while the browser reports a data saver connection. Sync now still works.

lives.title: Where your data lives
lives.note: The data file holds your villages in a form that the sync can merge, so it is not a backup file. The meta file holds the list of devices and no game data. Your sign in is never in either file.

notes.google: The Gamerdex folder is visible in your Drive. Gamerdex can open only the files that it created.
notes.github: Keep the repository private. Anyone who can open it can read your data.
notes.dropbox: The Gamerdex folder is inside the Apps folder of your Dropbox. Gamerdex can open only that folder.
notes.microsoft: The Gamerdex folder is inside the Apps folder of your OneDrive. Gamerdex can open only that folder.

device.title: This device
device.name: Device name
device.nameHint: The sync files show this name for this device. Renaming it updates the meta file on the next sync.
device.loginHint: The active village is a choice on each device, and sync never changes it. Your sign in stays on this device. It is never in the saved data, the backup file or the sync files.

disconnect.title: Disconnect
disconnect.body: Stops syncing on this browser. Your villages stay on this device and in the cloud. Other devices keep syncing.

hints.google: To delete the cloud copy yourself, disconnect, then delete the Gamerdex folder in your Google Drive.
hints.github: To delete the cloud copy yourself, disconnect, then delete the Gamerdex folder in your repository.
hints.dropbox: To delete the cloud copy yourself, disconnect, then delete the app folder under Apps in your Dropbox.
hints.microsoft: To delete the cloud copy yourself, disconnect, then delete the app folder under Apps in your OneDrive.
